name: im.zego.zpns_android_plugin_vivo.VivoMessageReceiver
description: When Vivo Push reports a registration token, a user taps a notification, or a pass-through message arrives, this ZEGO adapter packages the event and sends it to the ZEGO push system.
disableEffect: Vivo push messages, notification clicks, and registration updates will no longer reach ZEGO through this adapter.
